capture: Incidents Dashboard on a demo account with the School Incident Management template: the four number tiles, the filter row (Search, Mine, Status, Category, Severity, Involves, Lead, Student name, From, To), the line 'Showing x of y', and the Board with a few incidents in different columns. Use sample incidents, not real ones. Do not click into a card.

Dashboard, click 'Raise Incident'. Capture the open form showing Title, What happened?, Incident type, the four Severity buttons and the single line 'This incident involves (n)', with sample non-sensitive text filled in. Do not click Submit report.

Open a sample incident past 'Reported' with a lead set. Capture the top (reference, status, Severity/Status/Type/Incident lead fields, Escalate now), the Timeline with a note, the Evidence files box and the Required steps list showing one done and one overdue. Do not change any field.
